source: Kaggle dataset mikoajfish99/us-recession-and-financial-indicators (FRED series plus Investing.com S&P 500 prices)

columns.GDP_YOY: FRED GDP (quarterly, nominal), YoY % vs the same quarter a year earlier; released once per quarter and HELD until the next release
columns.CLAIMS_YOY: FRED CCSA continued claims (weekly), last weekly value at or before month-end, YoY %
columns.FEDFUNDS: FRED DFF effective federal funds rate (daily), last value at or before month-end, level in percent
columns.UNRATE: FRED UNRATE unemployment rate (monthly, seasonally adjusted), level in percent
columns.CPI_YOY_SA: FRED CPIAUCSL CPI-U all items, SEASONALLY ADJUSTED (not the NSA series the INFLATIONCAST target uses), YoY %
columns.BANK_CREDIT_YOY: FRED TOTBKCR bank credit of all commercial banks (weekly), last weekly value at or before month-end, YoY %
columns.SPX_YOY: Investing.com S&P 500 daily close, last close at or before month-end, YoY %
columns.SPX_VOL: annualised realised volatility (%) of the month's daily log returns, needs >= 15 returns

publication_lag_note: FIXED, documented assumptions (not fetched release vintages; ALFRED is unreachable here). A period's value is re-keyed to the first month-end at or after (period end + lag), so the value on row M is knowable by M's own end.

grid.note: blank cell = series does not exist yet; the grid is NOT rectangular
